target: DOCUMENTARY SIX-SLOT AUTHOR DRAFT for math; exact source fidelity, not scientific review or final acceptance.
control_use: STATUS ONLY: no quarantined computational/selected episode, prior returned review body, outcome, selection or confidence consumer is mathematical input. Do not follow excluded links.

inputs.role: Exact original owner/obligation and last-four historical ledger rows per slot.
Documentary current-snapshot framing and global boundaries.
Prior documentary-audit scope/status; no new science.

audit: Write six compact slot summaries, each naming the exact original target, one or more scoped results supported by supplied ledger rows, and the precise open or held boundary. Apply later corrections/holds within each provided row sequence. A conditional claim keeps every condition; do not treat row count or dispatch as discovery. If four-row snapshot is insufficient to establish current status, say NOT ESTABLISHED and cite latest record only. Do not follow any linked file or held body, infer novelty, state total closed-problem counts, or independently prove source mathematics. Output is a draft for parent validation, not final report.

rules.prebody: Read manifest, freeze receipt and status-only controls, then send administrative pre-body ACK before mathematical packet reads. Read entire packet raw in windows <=20LF, all endings, before deriving; recover elision.
rules.science: WRITTEN_ONLY. No selected mathematical instances privately or publicly, no scientific code/CAS/interpreter/solver/enumeration/replay; metadata/hash/date allowed. No prior reviewer body, sibling, author code or held payload. Honor read-order corrections first, all imports exact-scope only.
rules.output: Own review-v1.md and reviewer-prefixed process records in this wave only. If write refused, return full review text for parent materialization without bypass. Per-claim SUPPORTED/REFUTED/INCONCLUSIVE with LF findings, exact imports and FATAL/MAJOR/MINOR. No blanket acceptance from incomplete reconstruction.
rules.cadence: Fresh clocks and substantive checkpoints <=30min while active; return promptly after delivery/blocker, no unbounded wait. Skip builds/lints/tests/formatters.

parent_scope: Pre-freeze parent read of listed candidate text is not adoption.
